text:
Why are the outside walls of houses often painted white in very hot countries?
A
White surfaces are good absorbers of infrared radiation.
B
White surfaces are good emitters of infrared radiation.
C
White surfaces are poor absorbers of infrared radiation.
D
White surfaces are poor reflectors of infrared radiation.
